additional_context: FHIR-14010 is the same change family and requested adding the ECL query value. FHIR-14359 corrected the separator to match existing implicit URI formats and is already represented on the combined branch. Vocab minutes and Zulip discussion support the slash separator. FHIR-35933 later migrated the old core external terminology pages to THO, and the current linked THO SNOMED CT page contains the ECL syntax and template.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No current FHIR core source edit is needed because the detailed SNOMED CT implicit value set guidance is outside current core build scope and is already correct in the THO page linked from core.
